description.value: A historic roundhouse building in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, this is the city's only combined arts and recreation centre. It houses Engine 374, the first transcontinental passenger train to arrive in Vancouver, and offers a wide range of programs, exhibitions, and community events. The converted brick industrial building has been a community landmark since the late 1980s.
